brief: A 4-second brand-lockup sting in the site's dark-field, gold-accent palette. The gold ring logo draws itself in over 2.5 seconds via SVG stroke-dashoffset animation (circumference ~75.4), establishing the center dot as the final focal point revealed at 2.5s via scale_grow. It holds in negative space with a soft gold glow bloom while the hero tagline 'I build things that live on the web' sweeps in from the right beneath the mark on a power4 ease, accompanied by an underline_sweep. A clean lockup holds to 4s. Motion is deliberately slow and elegant — nothing flashy, just the mark and the message. Exports transparent (alpha-overlay) for use as a brand sting overlaid on other footage.
